Email template — Receipt

Email templates for receipts allow you to automatically send payment confirmations to customers when you record their payments in the system.

This template will be used whenever you email a receipt directly from the Receipts tab, ensuring consistent communication with your customers.

Template Configuration

The Subject field determines what appears in the email subject line. You can include placeholders that will be automatically replaced with actual values when the email is sent.

The Message Body contains the main content of your email. Use placeholders to automatically insert receipt details, customer information, and payment amounts.

Available Placeholders

Placeholders are special codes that get replaced with actual data when sending emails. Common placeholders include customer name, receipt number, payment amount, and payment date.

To see all available placeholders, click the Insert Placeholder button when editing the template. This will show you a complete list of dynamic content you can include.

Subject

Default email subject line when emailing receipts.

Message body

Default email body text when emailing receipts. You can include merge fields to personalize the message.
